extracted.intended_audience: EU stakeholders, project proponents, partners, and the general public seeking information about the European Investment Bank
extracted.subtask_description: A short institutional overview describing the European Investment Bank's role, priorities, governance, and commitments that indicate the kinds of activities and principles the EIB supports and expects from projects it finances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role as the lending arm of the European Union
rubrics_metrics.description: The European Investment Bank is the lending arm of the European Union; one of the biggest multilateral financial institutions in the world and one of the largest providers of climate finance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positioning implies eligibility/priority for EU-focused projects and a strong emphasis on climate-related financing and large-scale multilateral operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority — accelerate the green transition
rubrics_metrics.description: Through our activities, we aim to accelerate the green transition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that contribute to decarbonisation, renewable energy, energy efficiency, and other green-transition goals align with the EIB's stated priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority — boost technological innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Through our activities, we aim to boost technological innovation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that advance technological development, innovation adoption, and related R&D are indicated as priorities for support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority — bolster security and defence
rubrics_metrics.description: Through our activities, we aim to bolster security and defence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Activities that enhance security and defence capabilities are listed among institutional priorities and may be considered for financing where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority — support regional cohesion and social infrastructure development
rubrics_metrics.description: Through our activities, we aim to support regional cohesion and social infrastructure development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that promote territorial cohesion, social infrastructure (e.g., health, education, transport) and reduce regional disparities align with EIB objectives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to international development and capital markets integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Our commitment to international development and capital markets integration safeguards Europe’s strong global presence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Initiatives that foster international development, integration of capital markets, and strengthen Europe’s global economic role are consistent with the EIB's mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Corporate responsibility — commitment to sustainable development
rubrics_metrics.description: Corporate responsibility: Read about our commitment to sustainable development, the foundation of our business model.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sustainability is presented as foundational; projects and partners are expected to align with sustainable development principles and corporate-responsibility standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Governance & structure — decision-making, processes and controls
rubrics_metrics.description: Governance & structure: Find out more about our decision-making structure, processes, and associated controls.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises structured governance and controls; stakeholders should expect formal decision processes and compliance requirements in project appraisal and approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency & access to information — listening to citizens
rubrics_metrics.description: Transparency & access to information: Find out how we listen to citizens when they need information or have concerns about EIB projects, policy or activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates expectations for openness, stakeholder engagement, and mechanisms for information access and complaints or concerns handling.
